intent: Define the Button appearance and behavior for Horizon, including keyboard use, disabled/loading states and composition. This is a work contract for component design and validation.

states.expected: Approved dimensions, typography, shape and semantic tone.
Visible token-based focus and one activation, with an accessible name.
Busy state is exposed and repeated actions are prevented.
Anchor semantics and forwarded props and ref.

tokens.name: --sl-radius-4
tokens.reason: Available large-radius option; its use in Button must be decided with design.

impact.summary: The work may change Button visuals and its shared component API. Record the final changes and affected consumers before review.
impact.consumerAction: Select the Horizon stylesheet when adopting this appearance. Follow the final usage examples and any API adjustments recorded by the component work.

openQuestions: Which shape, tone and size combinations belong in the reusable Button API?
Which dimensions and interactive states are the approved design reference?

evidence.description: Record ref, props and behavioral unit checks for the final implementation.
Record keyboard, disabled, loading and composition Storybook interaction results.
Review the agreed Show matrix in the target theme.
Record axe results and manual focus, keyboard, zoom and screen-reader review.
Build and type-check consumer usage, refs and asChild.
Record measured package line coverage against the repository requirement.
Exercise the shared Button and its states in every theme declared in target.themes.
